newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - HydroChem Industrial sells $110 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - HydroChem Industrial sells $110 mln debt.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of high-yield debt from HydroChem Industrial Service Inc was priced on Wednesday via Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette, according to market sources.
The Houston, Texas-based company is a wholly-owned subsidiary of HydroChem Holding Inc.
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 2/1/98 LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 10.375 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS SPREAD 450.5 BPS CALLABLE NON CALL FIVE
NOTE: THREE-YEAR EQUITY CLAWBACK FOR UP TO 35 PERCENT OF THE ISSUE AT 109.375 PERCENT OF PRINCIPAL.
